definition.path: URL.pathname stripped of trailing /, empty => /. method uppercased. Catalog matching precedes auth/dispatch. Slug decoded once and must pass isValidSlug with no embedded slash; malformed encoding cannot select ledger. Known catalog path/wrong method => 405; unknown /api path => 404. Imperative regex may further constrain resource path. Query get uses first value unless getAll validation appears in operation.
definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.
definition.transportExclusions: HTTP operation: no CLI invocation/argv/stdout or MCP request/result framing. Equivalent core CLI/MCP may exist but this row does not assert their wire availability. /api/auth/* except sign-up is exclusively delegated to configured Better Auth; sign-up blocked 404. Non-api GET/HEAD may serve static SPA fallback; API errors remain JSON.

export function intercompanyDispositionStatus(db:Database,workspace:string,id:string,asOf=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)){const current=state(db,text(id,"disposition id",80));if(!current)return null;const exceptions:any[]=[];for(const link of current.links){try{const actual=snapshot(workspace,link.company_slug,link.journal_entry_id);if(actual.entry.entry_hash!==link.journal_entry_hash||actual.ledgerHeadHash!==link.ledger_head_hash)exceptions.push({kind:"stale_or_reversed_journal",side:link.side,waivable:false});else assertLinkMatches(current,link.side,actual);}catch(error){exceptions.push({kind:"stale_or_reversed_journal",side:link.side,waivable:false});}}
if(current.status==="partly_posted")exceptions.push({kind:"one_sided_posting",side:current.links[0]?.side,waivable:false});if(current.status!=="settled"&&current.disposition.settlementDueDate&&current.disposition.settlementDueDate<date(asOf,"asOf"))exceptions.push({kind:"overdue_settlement",dueDate:current.disposition.settlementDueDate,waivable:false});return {...current,exceptions,balanced:current.status==="posted"&&exceptions.length===0,scope:"intercompany-disposition-status" as const};}

coreContracts.implementation: export function proposeIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,input:unknown,audit:{actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){const value=parse(input);requireRecordAndParties(db,value);return db.transaction(()=>{const exists=state(db,value.dispositionId);const payload=canonical(value);if(exists){if(exists.payloadHash===sha(payload)&&exists.status==="proposed")return exists;throw new Error("disposition id already exists with a different or completed lifecycle");}db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_dispositions(disposition_id,canonical_payload,payload_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?)").run(value.dispositionId,payload,sha(payload),new Date().toISOString());event(db,value.dispositionId,"proposed",value,audit.actor,audit.principal);return state(db,value.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.resultType: any
coreContracts.implementation: export function approveIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,id:string,payloadHash:string,audit:{actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(id,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==payloadHash)throw new Error("exact proposed disposition was not found");if(current.status==="approved"||current.status==="partly_posted"||current.status==="posted")return current;if(current.status!=="proposed")throw new Error("exact proposed disposition was not found");const proposer=current.events[0];if(proposer.principal_kind===audit.principal.kind&&proposer.principal_id===audit.principal.id)throw new Error("disposition approval requires a distinct stable principal");event(db,id,"approved",{payloadHash},audit.actor,audit.principal);return state(db,id)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.resultType: any
coreContracts.implementation: export function linkIntercompanyDispositionJournal(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;side:DispositionSide;journalEntryId:number;expectedLedgerHeadHash:string|null;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.status!=="approved"&&current.status!=="partly_posted")throw new Error("only approved dispositions can link journals");if(current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("exact disposition hash is required");if(current.links.some((link:any)=>link.side===input.side)){const old=current.links.find((link:any)=>link.side===input.side)!;if(old.journal_entry_id===input.journalEntryId){assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);return current;}throw new Error("disposition side already has an immutable journal link");}assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);const expected=current.disposition[input.side];const actual=snapshot(workspace,expected.companySlug,input.journalEntryId);if(actual.ledgerHeadHash!==input.expectedLedgerHeadHash)throw new Error("ledger head changed; refresh before linking");assertLinkMatches(current,input.side,actual);db.query("INSERT INTO rm_intercompany_disposition_journal_links(disposition_id,side,company_slug,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,journal_entry_hash,ledger_head_hash,linked_at,actor,principal_kind,principal_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run(input.dispositionId,input.side,expected.companySlug,input.journalEntryId,actual.entry.entry_no,actual.entry.entry_hash,actual.ledgerHeadHash,new Date().toISOString(),text(input.actor,"actor",160),input.principal.kind,text(input.principal.id,"principal id",160));lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception",{kind:"one_sided_posting",side:input.side,payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);if(current.links.length===1)lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"exception_resolved",{kind:"one_sided_posting",payloadHash:input.payloadHash},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.resultType: any
coreContracts.implementation: export function settleIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;settlementEvidenceRecordIds:string[];actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(current.status==="settled")return current;if(current.status!=="posted")throw new Error("exact fully posted disposition is required before settlement");if(!Array.isArray(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)||input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds.length<1)throw new Error("settlement requires source-linked evidence");for(const id of input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)if(!inspectCorporateRecord(db,text(id,"settlement evidence",160)))throw new Error("settlement corporate evidence does not exist");assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"settled",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,settlementEvidenceRecordIds:[...new Set(input.settlementEvidenceRecordIds)].sort()},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.implementation: export function supersedeIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;replacementDispositionId:string;reason:string;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash||["settled","superseded"].includes(current.status))throw new Error("active exact disposition is required for supersession");const replacement=text(input.replacementDispositionId,"replacement disposition id",80);if(replacement===input.dispositionId||!state(db,replacement))throw new Error("supersession requires a distinct existing replacement disposition");lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"superseded",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,replacementDispositionId:replacement,reason:text(input.reason,"supersession reason",1000)},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

coreContracts.implementation: export function reopenIntercompanyDisposition(db:Database,workspace:string,input:{dispositionId:string;payloadHash:string;reason:string;actor:string;principal:DispositionPrincipal}){return db.transaction(()=>{const current=state(db,text(input.dispositionId,"disposition id",80));if(!current||!["settled","superseded"].includes(current.status)||current.payloadHash!==input.payloadHash)throw new Error("only exact settled or superseded dispositions can be reopened");assertCurrentLinks(workspace,current);lifecycle(db,input.dispositionId,"reopened",{payloadHash:input.payloadHash,reason:text(input.reason,"reopen reason",1000)},input.actor,input.principal);return state(db,input.dispositionId)!;}).immediate();}

definition.legacyDynamicValues: SQL query results and explicitly cast unknown/any values are not runtime JSON-schema validated. They retain source SQL aliases/casing and values of the selected SQLite columns, including null; parsed stored JSON retains arbitrary JSON object/array/scalar contents. No narrower inferred DTO is asserted for those values. The concrete SQL/projection and result expressions below bind the legacy behavior, not a promise that any arbitrary JSON is successful.
preciseLegacyProjectionClarifications: Plan only reads workspace control, accepts request.json directly, requires read permission on both normalized distinct endpoints. Other actions require true confirmation and request origin/content-type checks, write only workspace control, and require ownership.manage for both endpoints and both replacement endpoints on supersede. Exceptions throw rather than return ok:false; unknown Error receives safe outer500, ApiError retains explicit400/401/404. Never open/migrate/backup-lock an arbitrary company ledger for the workspace-control mutation itself; link/settle/reopen may inspect linked company ledgers read-only through snapshot().

Disposition amount is positive two-decimal major-unit number, currency uppercase string; optional settlementDueDate omitted when absent. payloadHash/event hashes are SHA256 hex strings. Canonical payload JSON parsed in state is source-constructed IntercompanyDisposition; event canonical_payload remains string. journal_entry_id integer; ledger_head_hash nullable string. No invented generic JSON shape.

coreContracts.implementation: export function approvePartyMerge(db: Database, input:{ fromPartyId:string; proposalHash:string; actor:string; observedAt?:string }) { const from=inspectParty(db,input.fromPartyId); if(!from) throw new Error("party not found"); const proposal=db.query("SELECT canonical_payload FROM rm_party_events WHERE party_id=? AND event_type='proposed_merge' AND payload_hash=?").get(input.fromPartyId,input.proposalHash) as {canonical_payload:string}|null; if(!proposal) throw new Error("exact merge proposal not found"); const payload=JSON.parse(proposal.canonical_payload); event(db,input.fromPartyId,"approved_merge",from.kind,payload,input.actor,input.observedAt); event(db,input.fromPartyId,"superseded",from.kind,payload,input.actor,input.observedAt); return inspectParty(db,input.fromPartyId)!; }

coreContracts.implementation: export function proposePartyMerge(db: Database, input:{ fromPartyId:string; intoPartyId:string; reviewAssertion:string; actor:string; observedAt?:string }) { const from=inspectParty(db,input.fromPartyId), into=inspectParty(db,input.intoPartyId); if(!from||!into) throw new Error("both parties must exist"); if(from.partyId===into.partyId) throw new Error("cannot merge a party into itself"); return event(db,from.partyId,"proposed_merge",from.kind,{intoPartyId:into.partyId,reviewAssertion:text(input.reviewAssertion,"reviewAssertion",500)},input.actor,input.observedAt); }

ORDER BY id").all(id)as any[];const scopes=db.query("SELECT scope_kind,scope_id FROM rm_corporate_record_scope_assertions WHERE record_id=? ORDER BY scope_kind,scope_id").all(id)as any[];const type=events.length?JSON.parse(events[0].canonical_payload).type ?? "other":"other";return {recordId:id,type,sha256:row.sha256,filename:row.filename,source:row.source,receivedAt:row.received_at,recordDate:row.record_date,retentionUntil:row.retention_until,uploader:row.uploader,sensitivity:row.sensitivity,links:scopes.map(x=>({type:x.scope_kind,id:x.scope_id})),history:events.map(({canonical_payload,...event})=>event)};}

definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. coreContracts.implementation: export function listDocumentPartyLinks(ledger:Database, input:{status?:"linked"|"unlinked"|DocumentResolutionState;limit?:number}={}) { const linked="EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM current_document_party_links l WHERE l.document_id=d.id)"; const internal="EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM current_document_party_resolution_events r WHERE r.document_id=d.id)"; const state=`CASE WHEN ${internal} THEN 'internal_no_external_party' WHEN ${linked} THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'unresolved' END`; const wanted=input.status==="linked"?"resolved":input.status==="unlinked"?"unresolved":input.status; const where=wanted?`WHERE ${state}=?`:""; return ledger.query(`SELECT d.id,d.document_no,d.sha256_hash, ${linked} AS linked, ${state} AS resolution_state FROM documents d ${where} ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT ?`).all(...(wanted?[wanted,Math.min(Math.max(input.limit??100,1),100)]:[Math.min(Math.max(input.limit??100,1),100)])); }

definition.legacyDynamicValues: SQL query results and explicitly cast unknown/any values are not runtime JSON-schema validated. They retain source SQL aliases/casing and values of the selected SQLite columns, including null; parsed stored JSON retains arbitrary JSON object/array/scalar contents. No narrower inferred DTO is asserted for those values. The concrete SQL/projection and result expressions below bind the legacy behavior, not a promise that any arbitrary JSON is successful.
preciseLegacyProjectionClarifications: All integer event IDs are SQLite RETURNING id/current.id values. HTTP withCompanyMutation converts every core ok:false into ApiError before okResponse; returned errors[] are not a successful body variant. IDs/null/planHash/supersededId are exactly as declared above. No additional errors property is fabricated for definitions/members/assignment actions.

Assignment allocations amountMinor are positive safe integer minor units, sum per dimension equals legacy Math.round(abs(debit-credit)*100), currency normalized uppercase; member effective bounds and active current definition enforced. Replace appends superseded and assigned events in one immediate transaction; no journal-line or journal-hash edits. Budget allocations instead use amount:number in major units; reconcile within legacy 0.000001 tolerance, sourceRef required; atomic replace retains history.

definition.path: URL.pathname stripped of trailing /, empty => /. method uppercased. Catalog matching precedes auth/dispatch. definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.

No narrower inferred DTO is asserted for those values. The concrete SQL/projection and result expressions below bind the legacy behavior, not a promise that any arbitrary JSON is successful.
preciseLegacyProjectionClarifications: All integer event IDs are SQLite RETURNING id/current.id values. HTTP withCompanyMutation converts every core ok:false into ApiError before okResponse; returned errors[] are not a successful body variant. IDs/null/planHash/supersededId are exactly as declared above. No additional errors property is fabricated for definitions/members/assignment actions.

Assignment allocations amountMinor are positive safe integer minor units, sum per dimension equals legacy Math.round(abs(debit-credit)*100), currency normalized uppercase; member effective bounds and active current definition enforced. Replace appends superseded and assigned events in one immediate transaction; no journal-line or journal-hash edits. Budget allocations instead use amount:number in major units; reconcile within legacy 0.000001 tolerance, sourceRef required; atomic replace retains history.

preciseLegacyProjectionClarifications: All integer event IDs are SQLite RETURNING id/current.id values. HTTP withCompanyMutation converts every core ok:false into ApiError before okResponse; returned errors[] are not a successful body variant. IDs/null/planHash/supersededId are exactly as declared above. No additional errors property is fabricated for definitions/members/assignment actions.

Assignment allocations amountMinor are positive safe integer minor units, sum per dimension equals legacy Math.round(abs(debit-credit)*100), currency normalized uppercase; member effective bounds and active current definition enforced. Replace appends superseded and assigned events in one immediate transaction; no journal-line or journal-hash edits. Budget allocations instead use amount:number in major units; reconcile within legacy 0.000001 tolerance, sourceRef required; atomic replace retains history.

definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.

definition.legacyDynamicValues: SQL query results and explicitly cast unknown/any values are not runtime JSON-schema validated. They retain source SQL aliases/casing and values of the selected SQLite columns, including null; parsed stored JSON retains arbitrary JSON object/array/scalar contents. No narrower inferred DTO is asserted for those values. The concrete SQL/projection and result expressions below bind the legacy behavior, not a promise that any arbitrary JSON is successful.
preciseLegacyProjectionClarifications: All integer event IDs are SQLite RETURNING id/current.id values. HTTP withCompanyMutation converts every core ok:false into ApiError before okResponse; returned errors[] are not a successful body variant. IDs/null/planHash/supersededId are exactly as declared above. No additional errors property is fabricated for definitions/members/assignment actions.

Assignment allocations amountMinor are positive safe integer minor units, sum per dimension equals legacy Math.round(abs(debit-credit)*100), currency normalized uppercase; member effective bounds and active current definition enforced. coreContracts.implementation: export function approveBookkeepingBatchPlan(db: Database, input: BatchActor & { principal?: BatchPrincipal; runId: number; planHash: string }) { if (!validActor(input.actor)) throw new Error("actor is required"); const principal=batchPrincipal(db,input); return db.transaction(() => { const revision = db.query("SELECT id,planner_kind,planner_subject_id FROM bookkeeping_batch_revisions WHERE run_id=? AND revision_hash=?").get(input.runId,input.planHash) as {id:number;planner_kind:BatchPrincipal['kind'];planner_subject_id:string}|null; if (!revision) throw new Error("exact pending plan was not found"); if (revision.planner_kind===principal.kind && revision.planner_subject_id===principal.subjectId) throw new Error("SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN"); const existing=db.query("SELECT 1 FROM bookkeeping_batch_revision_approvals WHERE revision_id=?").get(revision.id); if (!existing) { db.query("INSERT INTO bookkeeping_batch_revision_approvals(revision_id,principal_kind,principal_subject_id,actor,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)").run(revision.id,principal.kind,principal.subjectId,input.actor,new Date().toISOString()); event(db,input.runId,"approved",input.planHash,input.actor,{principal:{kind:principal.kind,subjectId:principal.subjectId}}); } return { ok: true as const }; }).immediate(); }

definition.authentication: Better Auth: public.read/public.invitation.claim bypass session lookup; other routes authenticate session/service principal once. Invalid/absent/stale database session => 401 missing or invalid credentials. Local authRequired=false is localhost-trusted; true requires configured Bearer secret on ALL routes including public. Authorization checks workspace/company membership before handler opens ledger; denied = 401 not 403, authorization audit appended without existence leak.
definition.originAndFreshness: Hosted unsafe requests require trusted Origin. High-risk permission unsafe Better Auth requests require server-clock session age 0..600000ms inclusive, else 401 unauthorized with subcode SESSION_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Service principals do not use browser session freshness gate. Company mutation pipeline additionally enforces local Host/origin/content-type, body size/JSON object, actor, confirm when configured, backup lock, revocation recheck and optional idempotency.
definition.cors: No general Access-Control-Allow-Origin or successful generic OPTIONS/preflight response in TS app/router. OPTIONS on catalog path is wrong-method 405 (after authentication). Mutation application/json/Origin enforcement is CSRF protection, not a CORS grant.
definition.transportExclusions: HTTP operation: no CLI invocation/argv/stdout or MCP request/result framing. operationCoreRefusals.implementation: export function buildCompanyCommitments(workspaceRoot:string,slug:string,startDate:string){if(!findWorkspaceCompany(workspaceRoot,slug))throw ApiError.notFound("virksomhed findes ikke");const path=companyPaths(companyRootForSlug(workspaceRoot,slug)).db;if(!existsSync(path))throw ApiError.notFound("virksomheden har ingen ledger");const db=openLedgerReadOnly(path);try{const rows=listSupplierCommitments(db).map(row=>{let commitment:any={};try{commitment=JSON.parse(row.payload_json);}catch{}return {commitmentId:row.commitment_id,payloadHash:row.payload_hash,createdAt:row.created_at,vendor:commitment.vendorSnapshot??commitment.vendorPartyId,purpose:commitment.businessPurpose??commitment.description,amount:commitment.amount??null,currency:commitment.currency??null,frequency:commitment.frequency??null,nextDate:commitment.nextDate??null,renewalDate:commitment.renewalDate??null,status:commitment.status??"active",evidenceRefs:commitment.evidenceRefs??[],missingDocument:false};});if(!isValidIsoDate(startDate))return {commitments:rows,matches:listSupplierCommitmentOccurrenceMatches(db),alerts:[],forecast:buildThirteenWeekLiquidityForecast(db,{startDate})};const control=existsSync(workspaceControlPaths(workspaceRoot).db)?openWorkspaceControlReadOnlyDb(workspaceRoot):null;try{return {commitments:rows,matches:listSupplierCommitmentOccurrenceMatches(db),alerts:supplierCommitmentAlerts(db,startDate),forecast:buildWorkspaceThirteenWeekLiquidityForecast(control,db,slug,startDate)};}finally{control?.close();}}finally{db.close();}}

coreContracts.implementation: export function listSupplierCommitmentOccurrenceMatches(db:Database,commitmentId?:string){const rows=(commitmentId?db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash,actor,principal,created_at FROM supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches WHERE commitment_id=? ORDER BY occurrence_date,id").all(commitmentId):db.query("SELECT canonical_payload,payload_hash,actor,principal,created_at FROM supplier_commitment_occurrence_matches ORDER BY commitment_id,occurrence_date,id").all()) as any[];return rows.map(row=>({...JSON.parse(row.canonical_payload),payloadHash:row.payload_hash,actor:row.actor,principal:row.principal,createdAt:row.created_at}));}

coreContracts.resultType: Array<any>
coreContracts.implementation: export function supplierCommitmentAlerts(db:Database,asOf:string){if(!isValidIsoDate(asOf))return [];const end=addDays(asOf,30);const alerts:any[]=[];for(const row of listSupplierCommitments(db)){const p=JSON.parse(row.payload_json) as CommitmentProposal;for(const [kind,date] of [["notice",p.noticeDate],["renewal",p.renewalDate]] as const)if(date&&date>=asOf&&date<=end)alerts.push({commitmentId:row.commitment_id,kind,date,severity:date===asOf?"due":"upcoming"});}return alerts.sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)||a.commitmentId.localeCompare(b.commitmentId));}

      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/import`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          fileName: input.fileName,
          content: input.content,
          enrichCvr: input.enrichCvr === true,
          confirm: true,
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.import),

  /**
   * Ingests a document/voucher (bilag) (#213, slice 3). The browser reads the
   * (possibly binary) file and passes it base64-encoded; the server decodes it
   * to a temp file and calls the same core ingest the CLI/MCP use. Destructive,
   * so the body carries `confirm: true`.
   */
  ingestDocument: (slug: string, input: DocumentIngestInput) =>
    request<{
      ok: true;
      document: { id: number | null; documentNo: string | null };
    }>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/documents/ingest`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        fileName: input.fileName,
        fileBase64: input.fileBase64,
        metadata: input.metadata,
        ...(input.vendorId ? { vendorId: input.vendorId } : {}),
        ...(input.force ? { force: true } : {}),
        confirm: true,
      }),
    }).then((r) => r.document),

  /**
   * #407 — read-side data backing the Bogfør-bilag modal: the bilag's fields
   * to prefill, the bookable expense accounts and the unmatched outgoing
   * bank transactions the owner can pair the bilag with.
   */
  documentBookingOptions: (slug: string, documentId: number, options?: ReadRequestOptions) =>
    request<{ ok: true; options: DocumentBookingOptions }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/documents/${documentId}/booking-options`,
      options,
    ).then((r) => r.options),

  /** Read-only preflight: no provider call and no state change. */
  documentVatPreflight: (slug: string, documentId: number, options?: ReadRequestOptions) =>
    request<{ ok: true; preflight: DocumentVatPreflight }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/documents/${documentId}/vat-preflight`,
      options,
    ).then((r) => r.preflight),

  /** Actor-attributed provider call, gated by the same mutation boundary as posting. */
  applyDocumentVatPreflight: (slug: string, documentId: number) =>
    request<{ ok: true; preflight: DocumentVatPreflight }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/documents/${documentId}/vat-preflight/apply`,
      { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ confirm: true }) },
    ).then((r) => r.preflight),

  /**
   * #407 — books an ingested purchase document (bilag) as an expense against
   * an unmatched outgoing bank transaction. Third caller of the SAME
   * `bookExpenseFromBank` core function the CLI's `expense book` and the MCP
   * tool use. Write-irreversible (it appends a journal entry that links both
   * the document and the bank transaction), so the body carries
   * `confirm: true`.
   */
  bookDocumentExpense: (slug: string, input: DocumentBookExpenseInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; booking: DocumentBookExpenseSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/documents/book-expense`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          documentId: input.documentId,
          bankTransactionId: input.bankTransactionId,
          expenseAccountNo: input.expenseAccountNo,
          ...(input.vatTreatment ? { vatTreatment: input.vatTreatment } : {}),
          ...(input.paymentAccountNo
            ? { paymentAccountNo: input.paymentAccountNo }
            : {}),
          ...(input.transactionDate
            ? { transactionDate: input.transactionDate }
            : {}),
          ...(input.text ? { text: input.text } : {}),
          confirm: true,
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.booking),
}

  calculateNativeInvoiceInterest: (slug:string,body:NativeInvoiceInterestCalculate) => request<{ok:true;interest:NativeInvoiceInterestResult}>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/interest/calculate`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body),readOnly:true}).then(r=>r.interest),
  registerNativeInvoiceInterest: (slug:string,body:NativeInvoiceInterestCalculate & {note?:string;confirm:true}) => request(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/interest/register`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body)}),
  postNativeInvoiceInterest: (slug:string,body:NativeInvoiceInterestPost) => request(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/interest/post`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body)}),

  registerNativeInvoiceCompensation: (slug:string,body:NativeInvoiceCompensationCalculate & {note?:string;confirm:true}) => request<{ok:true;compensation:NativeInvoiceCompensationResult}>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/compensation/register`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(r=>r.compensation),
  postNativeInvoiceCompensation: (slug:string,body:{invoiceDocumentId:number;transactionDate?:string;receivableAccountNo:string;compensationIncomeAccountNo:string;confirm:true}) => request<{ok:true;compensation:NativeInvoiceCompensationResult}>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/compensation/post`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body)}).then(r=>r.compensation),
  publicEInvoiceConfig: (slug:string,options?:ReadRequestOptions) => request<{ok:true;publicEInvoice:PublicEInvoiceConfig}>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/public-config`,options).then(r=>r.publicEInvoice),
  registerPublicEInvoice: (slug:string) => request<{ok:true;registration:{registered:true;outbound:true;environment:"test"|"production"}}>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/public-register`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify({confirm:true})}).then(r=>r.registration),
  invoiceReminderClaims: (slug:string,id:number) => request<{ok:true;reminderClaims:NativeReminderClaimStatus}>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/${id}/reminder-claims`).then(r=>r.reminderClaims),
  registerNativeReminder: (slug:string,body:{invoiceDocumentId:number;reminderDate:string;feeAmount:number;note?:string;confirm:true}) => request(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/reminders/register`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body)}),
  postNativeReminder: (slug:string,body:{invoiceDocumentId:number;reminderId:number;transactionDate?:string;receivableAccountNo:string;reminderIncomeAccountNo:string;confirm:true}) => request(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/reminders/post`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body)}),
  settleNativeInvoiceClaims: (slug:string,body:{invoiceDocumentId:number;bankTransactionId:number;confirm:true}) => request(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/claims/settle`,{method:"POST",body:JSON.stringify(body)}),
  refundInvoice: (slug: string, invoiceDocumentId: number, bankTransactionReference: string) =>
    request<{ ok: true; refund: { entryId: number; refundId: number; invoiceNumber: string; remainingCreditBalance: number } }>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/refund`, {
      method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ invoiceDocumentId, bankTransactionReference, confirm: true }),
    }).then(r => r.refund),
  postNativeInvoice: (slug: string, invoiceDocumentId: number, revenueAccountNo: string) =>
    request<{ ok: true; posting: { entryId: number; entryNo: string } }>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/post`, {
      method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ confirm: true, invoiceDocumentId, revenueAccountNo }),
    }).then(r => r.posting),
  invoices: (slug: string, year?: string, options?: ReadRequestOptions) =>
    request<InvoicesResponse>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices${
        year ? `?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}` : ""
      }`,
      options,
    ).then((r) => r.invoices),

  /**
   * URL of an issued invoice's PDF — opened directly in a new browser tab so
   * the owner can download or forward it. URL builder rather than a fetch:
   * the server serves the file inline (#378).
   */
  invoicePdfUrl: (slug: string, id: number) =>
    `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/${id}/pdf`,

  /** Recurring-invoice templates + their past generations for a company. */
  recurringInvoices: (slug: string, options?: ReadRequestOptions) =>
    request<RecurringInvoicesResponse>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/recurring-invoices`,
      options,
    ).then((r) => r.recurringInvoices),

  /**
   * Creates a recurring-invoice template (#386). The cockpit hands the server
   * a minimal `{name, interval, firstIssueDate, paymentTermsDays,
   * deliveryPeriodMode, notes, vatRatePercent, currency, customerId, buyer,
   * lines}`; the server runs `computeInvoiceAmounts` + `resolveInvoiceMasterData`
   * and then `createRecurringInvoiceTemplate` — the same core path the CLI's
   * `recurring-invoice create` uses. Write-irreversible (a template that
   * cannot be edited or deleted, only retired), so the body carries
   * `confirm: true` to match the surrounding write-routes.
   */
  createRecurringInvoiceTemplate: (
    slug: string,
    input: RecurringInvoiceTemplateInput,
  ) =>
    request<{ ok: true; template: RecurringInvoiceTemplateCreatedResult }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/recurring-invoices`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...input, confirm: true }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.template),

  /**
   * Generates the next invoice from a template for the given `asOfDate`. The
   * core is idempotent: a second call for the same period returns the existing
   * generation with `created: false`. Write-irreversible (issues an invoice
   * document), so the body carries `confirm: true`.
   */
  generateRecurringInvoice: (slug: string, templateId: number, asOfDate: string) =>
    request<{ ok: true; generation: RecurringInvoiceGenerationResult }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/recurring-invoices/${templateId}/generate`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ asOfDate, confirm: true }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.generation),

  /**
   * Retires (deactivates) a recurring-invoice template (#435). Templates are
   * append-only by schema, so this flips `active` from 1 -> 0 and audit-logs
   * the change; the cockpit hides the generate button on retired templates.
   * The trigger forbids reactivation — an owner who needs to change terms
   * creates a new template that supersedes the retired one.
   */
  retireRecurringInvoiceTemplate: (
    slug: string,
    templateId: number,
    reason?: string,
  ) =>
    request<{ ok: true; template: { id: number; retired: boolean } }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/recurring-invoices/${templateId}/retire`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          confirm: true,
          ...(reason ? { reason } : {}),
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.template),

  /**
   * #440 — forhåndsviser en faktura uden at udstede. Same body as
   * `issueInvoice`, but the server runs `previewIssuedInvoicePdf` instead of
   * `issueInvoice`: no sequence draw, no `documents` row, no `audit_log`
   * entry. The response is the raw PDF (Content-Type application/pdf) so the
   * cockpit can open it in a new tab via `URL.createObjectURL`. Errors come
   * back as the regular `{ok:false,error}` envelope (400 for validation,
   * 409 for unknown customer/master-data, 404 for unknown company).
   */
  previewInvoice: async (
    slug: string,
    input: InvoiceIssueInput,
  ): Promise<Blob> => {
    const response = await requestBlob(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/preview`,
      { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(invoiceRequestPayload(input)), readOnly: true },
    );
    return response.blob;
  },

  /**
   * Issues a sales invoice (#213, slice 4). The human enters the customer and
   * the line items; the server COMPUTES every line total, net, VAT and gross
   * via the same core path the CLI's `invoice create` uses — the human never
   * does invoice arithmetic. Issuing is a kladde (no journal entry yet), so no
   * `confirm` is required.
   */
  issueInvoice: (slug: string, input: InvoiceIssueInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; invoice: InvoiceIssueSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/issue`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(invoiceRequestPayload(input)),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.invoice),

  /**
   * Settles an issued invoice against a bank payment (#213, slice 4). The
   * human identifies the bank receipt by its transaction id or reference.
   * Write-irreversible, so the body carries `confirm: true`.
   */
  settleInvoice: (slug: string, input: InvoiceSettleInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; settlement: InvoiceSettleSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/settle`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          invoiceDocumentId: input.invoiceDocumentId,
          ...(input.bankTransactionId
            ? { bankTransactionId: input.bankTransactionId }
            : {}),
          ...(input.bankTransactionReference
            ? { bankTransactionReference: input.bankTransactionReference }
            : {}),
          ...(input.paymentDate ? { paymentDate: input.paymentDate } : {}),
          ...(input.amount !== undefined ? { amount: input.amount } : {}),
          confirm: true,
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.settlement),

  /**
   * Issues a credit note for an already-issued sales invoice (#412). The
   * human supplies the source invoice + a mandatory reason; Rentemester
   * computes the credit amount from the original gross unless `grossAmount`
   * is given. Write-irreversible (it inserts a credit-note document AND
   * appends a reversal journal entry), so the body carries `confirm: true`.
   */
  creditInvoice: (slug: string, input: InvoiceCreditNoteInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; creditNote: InvoiceCreditNoteSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/credit-note`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          invoiceDocumentId: input.invoiceDocumentId,
          issueDate: input.issueDate,
          reason: input.reason,
          ...(input.grossAmount !== undefined
            ? { grossAmount: input.grossAmount }
            : {}),
          ...(input.creditNoteNumber
            ? { creditNoteNumber: input.creditNoteNumber }
            : {}),
          confirm: true,
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.creditNote),

  /**
   * #429 — sends an issued invoice to the customer's e-mail with the PDF
   * attached, from the cockpit. Third caller of the SAME `sendInvoiceEmail`
   * core function the CLI's `invoice send` command and the MCP tool
   * `invoice_send_email` use, so the cockpit and the terminal produce a
   * byte-identical MIME message and `email_send_log` row.
   *
   * SMTP CONFIG (host/port/fromAddress + optional username/password) is read
   * server-side from `config/smtp.json` in the company directory — credentials
   * never enter the request body. Idempotent: an identical send collapses onto
   * the existing send-log row instead of re-transmitting. Write-irreversible
   * (an `email_send_log` row + an `audit_log` entry), so the body carries
   * `confirm: true`.
   */
  sendInvoiceByEmail: (slug: string, input: InvoiceSendEmailInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; delivery: InvoiceSendEmailSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/send-email`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          invoiceDocumentId: input.invoiceDocumentId,
          to: input.to,
          ...(input.kind ? { kind: input.kind } : {}),
          confirm: true,
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.delivery),

  /**
   * #434 — sends a payment reminder (betalingspaamindelse) for an overdue
   * issued invoice. Single endpoint that combines three core calls so the
   * cockpit's "Send rykker" action is a one-click write:
   *   1. `registerInvoiceReminder` — records the reminder + statutory fee
   *      (max 100 kr/reminder, max 3 reminders per rentel. § 9b),
   *   2. (optional, when `bookFee` is true) `postInvoiceReminderToLedger` —
   *      journals the fee against the customer receivable,
   *   3. `sendInvoiceEmail` with `kind: 'reminder'` — same SMTP transport as
   *      "Send på mail", so the message is byte-identical to a CLI send.
   *
   * Write-irreversible (it inserts an `invoice_reminders` row, may append a
   * journal entry, and always appends an `email_send_log` + `audit_log`
   * row), so the body carries `confirm: true`.
   */
  sendInvoiceReminder: (slug: string, input: InvoiceSendReminderInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; reminder: InvoiceSendReminderSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/send-reminder`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          invoiceDocumentId: input.invoiceDocumentId,
          to: input.to,
          bookFee: input.bookFee,
          ...(input.feeAmount !== undefined ? { feeAmount: input.feeAmount } : {}),
          confirm: true,
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.reminder),

  /**
   * Sends through the selected company's local DigiSense binding. The browser
   * never supplies a company key, access-point identity or credentials.
   */
  sendInvoiceAsEInvoice: (slug: string, input: InvoiceSendEInvoiceInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; submission: InvoiceSendEInvoiceSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/send-public`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          invoiceDocumentId: input.invoiceDocumentId,
          confirm: true,
        }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.submission),

  /** Observes a queued DigiSense delivery without ever redelivering it. */
  refreshEInvoiceStatus: (slug: string, input: InvoiceSendEInvoiceInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; submission: InvoiceSendEInvoiceSummary }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/invoices/send-public/status`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ invoiceDocumentId: input.invoiceDocumentId, confirm: true }),
      },
    ).then((r) => r.submission),
}

function invoiceRequestPayload(input: InvoiceIssueInput) {
  return {
    issueDate: input.issueDate,
    ...(input.deliveryDate !== undefined ? {deliveryDate: input.deliveryDate} : {}),
    ...(input.deliveryPeriodStart !== undefined ? {deliveryPeriodStart: input.deliveryPeriodStart} : {}),
    ...(input.deliveryPeriodEnd !== undefined ? {deliveryPeriodEnd: input.deliveryPeriodEnd} : {}),
    ...(input.unitCode !== undefined ? {unitCode: input.unitCode} : {}),
    ...(input.invoiceType !== undefined ? {invoiceType:input.invoiceType} : {}),
    ...(input.totals !== undefined ? {totals:input.totals} : {}),
    lines: input.lines,
    ...(input.vatTreatment !== undefined ? {vatTreatment:input.vatTreatment} : {}),
    ...(input.reverseChargeBasis !== undefined ? {reverseChargeBasis:input.reverseChargeBasis} : {}),

  createCustomer: (slug: string, input: CustomerInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; customer: { id: number } }>(

      { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(input) },
    ).then((r) => r.customer),

  /** Updates an existing customer — only the fields present in `input` change. */
  updateCustomer: (slug: string, id: number, input: Partial<CustomerInput>) =>
    request<{ ok: true; customer: { id: number; ok: boolean } }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/customers/${id}`,
      { method: "PATCH", body: JSON.stringify(input) },
    ).then((r) => r.customer),

  /**
   * #430 — sletter en kunde fra master data. Sletningen blokeres server-side
   * (returnerer ApiError) hvis kunden er i brug på en åben (ikke-betalt)
   * udstedt faktura; cockpittet viser fejlbeskeden verbatim. Bogførte
   * fakturaer beholder deres navne-snapshot — historikken er intakt.
   * Write-irreversibel, så body'en bærer `confirm: true`.
   */
  deleteCustomer: (slug: string, id: number) =>
    request<{ ok: true; customer: { id: number; deleted: boolean } }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/customers/${id}`,
      { method: "DELETE", body: JSON.stringify({ confirm: true }) },
    ).then((r) => r.customer),

  /** Creates a new vendor (#390). */
  createVendor: (slug: string, input: VendorInput) =>
    request<{ ok: true; vendor: { id: number } }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/vendors`,
      { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(input) },
    ).then((r) => r.vendor),

  /** Updates an existing vendor — only the fields present in `input` change. */
  updateVendor: (slug: string, id: number, input: Partial<VendorInput>) =>
    request<{ ok: true; vendor: { id: number; ok: boolean } }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/vendors/${id}`,
      { method: "PATCH", body: JSON.stringify(input) },
    ).then((r) => r.vendor),

  /**
   * #430 — sletter en leverandør. Blokeres hvis leverandøren er i brug på en
   * åben gæld (`payables` med `vendor_id`-FK). Write-irreversibel.
   */
  deleteVendor: (slug: string, id: number) =>
    request<{ ok: true; vendor: { id: number; deleted: boolean } }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/vendors/${id}`,
      { method: "DELETE", body: JSON.stringify({ confirm: true }) },
    ).then((r) => r.vendor),

  /**
   * Looks an 8-digit Danish CVR number up in the CVR register (#390). The
   * credentials live on the server; the browser only ever sees the resolved
   * snapshot. A missing-credentials response is returned with `ok:false`
   * inside the envelope so the modal can show a calm hint, not an error.
   */
  cvrLookup: (slug: string, cvr: string, options?: ReadRequestOptions) =>
    request<{ ok: true; cvr: CvrLookupResult }>(
      `/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/cvr-lookup?cvr=${encodeURIComponent(cvr)}`, options,
    ).then((r) => r.cvr),
}

}

Står du fast? Her er en samlet vej til dokumentation, kontakt og fejlrapportering. Linkene åbner i ny fane.

Dokumentation

  • Sådan virker det {" "} — kort intro til hvordan Rentemester bogfører for dig.
  • Funktioner {" "} — overblik over hvad cockpittet kan.
  • Brugerguide {" "} — kom-i-gang-vejledning fra installation til første postering.

Kom i gang

Fem trin fra installeret cockpit til moms:

  1. Opret virksomheden under “Tilføj virksomhed”.
  2. Importér kontoudtog under “Bank”.
  3. Indlæs og bogfør bilag under “Bilag”.
  4. Afstem bank-bevægelser under “Bank”.
  5. Generér momsangivelse under “Moms” når perioden er slut.

“Posteringer” er en visning over alt der allerede er bogført — ikke et bogføringssted.

Kontakt og support

  • Kontakt {" "} — skriv direkte til teamet bag Rentemester.
  • Rapportér en fejl på GitHub {" "} — åbn et issue hvis cockpittet driller.

uiClosureVocabulary.uiScreenClosures: Per-screen symbol-reachable activity including recursive children and hooks. Lists reference exact uiActivityRecords in this file. Shared shell has its separate admission conditions.
uiClosureVocabulary.uiBehaviorDefinitions: Exact source definitions and recursive type declarations, interned by source location. Containing function bodies preserve callback/effect ordering, short-circuit conditions, return/throw and state updates.
uiClosureVocabulary.uiActivityRecords: Concrete call expressions and resultType, component mounts and actual props, hook/browser effects and full conditional/failure branches. Each belongs to an exact owner definition. Presence in source closure is conditional reachability, not runtime invocation or permission.
uiClosureVocabulary.externalLibraryTypes: TypeScript expands installed dependency declarations where resolvable. External SDK types may themselves use unknown/any; application payload, named SDK method, config and handling are exact source contracts. Source types do not assert runtime body validation where none exists.

setup.activityRecordTable: uiActivityRecords; owner references uiBehaviorDefinitions in this same JSON.
setup.mountCondition: App valid health profile and backend===rust and setupRequired; render WorkspaceSetupView before AuthProvider/AuthGate. onComplete=health.reload. No CockpitApp or ordinary requested route mounts while setup gate is active.

verification.activityRecordTable: uiActivityRecords; owner references uiBehaviorDefinitions in this same JSON.
verification.mountCondition: Hosted AuthGate has session but !session.emailVerified. AuthProvider is present; VerificationRequiredView replaces requested route, with generic resend acknowledgement and retry:0; no claim of actual email delivery.

mfa.activityRecordTable: uiActivityRecords; owner references uiBehaviorDefinitions in this same JSON.
mfa.mountCondition: Hosted AuthGate has email-verified session but !session.twoFactorEnabled. AuthProvider is present; MfaEnrollmentView replaces requested route until ceremony. Separate native-enrollment flow in LoginView remains bound in existing LoginView closure.

app/src/lib/types.ts.runtimeEffects: No runtime request/effect. Type reexports resolve to concrete declarations already bound by the consuming API/component closure. The bank-matches addition exposes DTOs; it creates no route or ledger behavior.
